explication: Osmedeus is a security workflow orchestration engine, exposed through a CLI and REST API. Users select or trigger YAML workflows; workflows are parsed, then executed through host, Docker, or SSH runners and can use utility functions, LLM agents, or distributed workers. Results and operational data are retained for queries and surfaced through the API and embedded dashboard. The README documents the major capabilities; source excerpts show several key call paths, while some subsystem connections below are documented only at a high level.
